claim: Long-only: go long S&P 100 stocks during the option-expiration week (the week containing the month's 3rd Friday), cash otherwise. Quantpedia summary of Stivers & Sun (2013, J. Banking & Finance) backtest 1988-2010: annualized return 9.3%, Sharpe 0.61, volatility ~8.7%, max drawdown -15.14%. Mechanism: option market-maker delta-hedge rebalancing reduces short-stock hedge positions during the expiration week.
quote: go long S&P 100 stocks during the option-expiration week and stay in cash during other days
limitations: Practitioner summary page, not the original paper text (paywalled at ScienceDirect); sample is old (1988-2010, ends 15+ years before this iteration's anchor window) and disclosed with no updated/recent-period figure. Grounds the OPEX_*_WEEK primary candidates' mechanism and rule construction, not assumed to transfer to 2024-2026 -- the local backtest is the decisive test.
independent_replication: Original academic paper independently located via WebSearch (Stivers & Sun 2013, J. Banking & Finance 37(11):4226-4240, ScienceDirect abstract cross-checked) -- see stivers-sun-2013-websearch-note.md.
impact_on_spec: Grounds the OPEX_{SPY,QQQ,DIA,IWM}_WEEK candidates: entry before the expiration week's Monday, exit at the expiration week's own last trading day.

Studies delta-hedged OPTION returns, not raw stock/ETF returns; no long-only stock Sharpe/CAGR is reported by this paper.

claim: Cboe Regulatory Circular RG13-118/C2 RG13-041 (2013-08-29): standard monthly option expiration is the third Friday of the month; if that Friday is a day the exchange is not open for business, expiration shifts to the PRECEDING trading day the exchange is open.
quote: the third Friday of the expiration month of such option contract, unless designated as ‘Grandfathered’ ..., or if such Friday is a day on which the exchange on which such option is listed is not open for business, the preceding day on which such exchange is open for business
limitations: WebFetch could not parse the raw PDF; full text extracted via curl+pdftotext. Official exchange rule, not a practitioner summary -- highest credibility for the calendar-boundary definition used by this batch.
